# OpenELA

> The Open Enterprise Linux Association, founded by CIQ, Oracle, and SUSE, provides free Enterprise Linux source code and the ELValidated compatibility standard.

OpenELA, the Open Enterprise Linux Association, is a non-profit trade association founded in August 2023 by CIQ, Oracle, and SUSE. It maintains freely available, redistributable Enterprise Linux source code that is compatible with Red Hat Enterprise Linux, and publishes ELValidated, an open source test suite that defines Enterprise Linux ABI compatibility. OpenELA does not ship a binary distribution. Downstream distributions such as Rocky Linux, Oracle Linux, and SUSE Multi-Linux Support build from its sources. Everything OpenELA publishes is open source and governed through a Board, a Technical Steering Committee, and community working groups.

## Pages

- [About](https://openela.github.io/openela.org-preview/openela/openela.org/pr/80/about/): How OpenELA stewards open Enterprise Linux source, the ELValidated compatibility standard, and open governance with founding members CIQ, Oracle, and SUSE.
- [ELValidated Compatibility Test Suite](https://openela.github.io/openela.org-preview/openela/openela.org/pr/80/elvalidated/): ELValidated is the OpenELA open source test suite for Enterprise Linux ABI compatibility. Validate your software once and run it on every compatible distribution.
- [Enterprise Linux Sources](https://openela.github.io/openela.org-preview/openela/openela.org/pr/80/sources/): Browse the OpenELA public Enterprise Linux source repositories. Build from source, contribute patches, or maintain your own derived distribution.
- [Supporting Tools](https://openela.github.io/openela.org-preview/openela/openela.org/pr/80/supporting-tools/): Tools maintained by the OpenELA community, including Mothership for source archiving and attestation and Leapp for in-place Enterprise Linux upgrades.
- [Join OpenELA](https://openela.github.io/openela.org-preview/openela/openela.org/pr/80/join/): Become an OpenELA member to help shape the Enterprise Linux compatibility standard, reduce support costs, and support a vendor-neutral open EL commons.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://openela.github.io/openela.org-preview/openela/openela.org/pr/80/faq/): Answers to common questions about OpenELA, including what it is, how it relates to RHEL, what ELValidated does, licensing, security updates, and how to get involved.

## Source code and projects

- [Enterprise Linux source repositories](https://github.com/orgs/openela-main/repositories): Package sources for the OpenELA Enterprise Linux distribution.
- [OpenELA on GitHub](https://github.com/openela): Tools, documentation, and project repositories.
- [Governance](https://github.com/openela/governance): Charter, bylaws, and governance documents.
- [ELValidated](https://github.com/openela/Compatibility): The Enterprise Linux ABI compatibility test suite.
- [Mothership](https://github.com/openela/mothership): Tools and services to archive RPM package sources and attest to their authenticity.
- [Leapp](https://github.com/oamg/leapp): In-place upgrade tooling for moving workloads to newer Enterprise Linux versions.
- [End user documentation](https://github.com/openela/openela-documentation): Documentation sources for Enterprise Linux users.
- [Linux 4.14 long term support](https://github.com/openela/kernel-lts/tree/linux-4.14.y): Kernel maintenance after upstream community support ended.
